description: Pay for an order with the account's card: real money. BEFORE calling it, tell the person the total (shipping included) and ask them to confirm; call it only after they say yes, unless they clearly asked to pay right now ("buy it now", "go ahead and pay"). "Order", "make an order" or "order these" alone is NOT that: create the order, show the total, and ask. Pass the quoteId and totalCents of the order's offer (create_order, update_order or get_order). The same idempotencyKey never charges twice. If paying is not set up (Owner only, a spending limit, a card), the order is held, nothing is charged, and the result says what the person must do.

accepted.description: Older form: the whole offer object instead of quoteId and totalCents

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string; reuse it on a retry

totalCents.description: The offer's total, as told to the person
